answer: Prayers & Duties >> Waqf, Mosque, Madrasa Question ID: 48586 Country: India Title: Demolishing old MASJID AND constructing NEW MASJID Question: My question is we are having salah (namaz) in our masjid from years back, but now we are having problem of insufficient place for namazi, so we have build a new masjid by side of our masjid and we have build it 60% all floors are ready finishing work is going on, and we have started all our prayers in new Masjid from Ramadan and till date, and we are not praying in old masjid. Our Hafiz Ji has told that we cannot keep our old masjid without prayers we should start prayers in old masjid or ask for mufti of Deoband they can give you right answer. We have kept a door to enter in old masjid, some of them are telling that there is no problem as we have built new Masjid we should salah prayers their only. Please give me right answer so I can do a right thing. Answer ID: 48586 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1384/1384/M=11/1434) When the old mosque was going to be congested then it should be expanded as per the capacity. And if it was dilapidated then it should have been reconstructed and the expansion should have been made as per the capacity. But if you intended to construct new mosque then the old and new one should have been combined and one spacious mosque should have been erected. It is not known what the distance between both the mosques is? However, if the new and old mosques are located separated then it is wrong to leave it and not to offer salah therein, Jamah should be held therein as well. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
